task: D9.12 Candidate pools page uses Manager API as the only business read and fails closed without legacy fallback
decision: The candidate pool GET route is now manager-owned. Flask maps /v1/candidate-edge-pools to the existing candidate page DTO, including anchorGroups, shared/YC/ZC pools, pairs, abnormal sections, pagination and token metadata, and returns manager_read_failed with dataSource=manager when the manager response is unavailable, malformed or out of scope. Legacy candidate loaders/bootstrap/paginator are not called by this route. The refresh endpoint remains a legacy maintenance entry until the M3 production builder/apply authority is switched, so the GET cutover does not also claim the write authority.
changes: CandidateEdgeSnapshot gains a bounded tokens array read from token_library_catalog for only the anchors/candidates referenced by the current candidate scope

Candidate page GET calls candidate_manager_page_payload unconditionally and no longer calls _bootstrap_dex_surface_dependencies, dex_pool_candidates_payload, paginate_candidate_payload or candidate_manager_shadow_payload
Candidate DTO validates status.enabled and status.chainId, required arrays and optional tokens array before rendering
Candidate page summary exposes usdDepthRequired=false and keeps manager status counts separate from bounded snapshot row counts
Manager read failure returns HTTP 503 with manager_read_failed, dataSource=manager and managerDetail; no legacy fallback
Candidate refresh route remains legacy-only for maintenance until M3 authority/apply cutover
Architecture and functional tests lock the candidate GET authority boundary and manager DTO fields

fixtures: Candidate manager DTO maps token metadata, abnormal tokens, anchor groups, shared/YC/ZC pools, pairs and per-group pagination
Candidate manager DTO accepts empty snapshots and page=1000/page_size=60 deterministically
Candidate manager DTO rejects wrong-chain scope and malformed token field
Candidate route calls only candidate_manager_page_payload and returns manager_read_failed on manager error

Rust candidate snapshot returns USDG/TA/TB token metadata from the current candidate scope
